headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Chicago White Sox in a high-scoring matchup, ultimately securing a 9-8 victory. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 13-1 win behind a strong performance from their offense and pitching staff. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' charge with a 2-home run, 6-RBI night. The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Matt Chapman has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain with the San Francisco Giants. Trevor McDonald was also transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list with the Giants, this time due to a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with the Boston Red Sox due to right elbow inflammation. James Outman has been placed on the 7-day injured list with the Detroit Tigers due to a concussion. Endy Rodríguez has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with the Pittsburgh Pirates due to left hip inflammation. Jake Bloss has been placed on the 60-day injured list with the Toronto Blue Jays. Riley Greene has been placed on the 10-day injured list with the Detroit Tigers due to a right hamstring strain. Kyle Karros has been placed on the 7-day injured list with the Colorado Rockies due to a concussion.

There have been several trades and roster moves in the past few days. Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Miami Marlins have traded 1B Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals.
